Several papers address LLMs for recommendation and popularity-related prediction, but the closest match is a fine-tuned LLM that jointly predicts short-term item popularity and generates explanations [1]. If you want recommendation reranking rather than popularity forecasting, another paper uses an LLM as an explainable re-ranker to improve ranking accuracy and interpretability [2].

For popularity bias specifically, one paper uses LLMs to model and address popularity bias with a semantically aware fairness framework [8], and another studies how popularity affects variable-length tokenization in generative recommendation [7].
